entities.summary: The Islamic University of Applied Sciences Rotterdam (IUASR) was founded on 21 November 1997 by the Turkish-Dutch scholar Dr. S.T.K. Damra. He served as the founding rector of the university and led the institution until his departure in 2001. The first chairman of the board was educator and author Hamdi Mert.
